$comment: Provenance pin for the vendored ID Churn Sentinel artifacts. api/sentinel.ts refuses to run when a vendored file's sha256 disagrees with this record, when its schema_version leaves the pinned major, or when a file is missing. A drifted vendor copy must fail loudly: silently matching nothing would render an absence of signal as an all-clear, which is the defect class this repository names in its own audits.
